```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"After many days of protests, the Hong Kong government agreed to have a representative meet with the students.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This promise for negotiations was obviated by a wave of violent attacks on peaceful protesters by thugs, often with police looking the other way or sometimes abetting the efforts of the vigilantes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Fighters for democracy have courageously resisted with nonviolent tactics.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for ceasing repressive violence against the protesters, whether it comes from official government sources or from thugs acting in concert with the government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Hong Kong government should immediately negotiate with students and other representatives of the democracy movement to resolve the underlying issues, including the establishment of genuine universal suffrage and initial measures to restrict the growth of extreme economic and social inequality.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Applauding the initiative and courage of those participating in the Hong Kong Movement for Democracy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to support the struggle by making use of democratic rights in appropriate ways to publicize, petition and protest in solidarity with the Hong Kong Movement for Democracy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
